summary: Design AI role-impact assessments, transition pathways, and ROI measures. Build a practical 12-month reskilling roadmap for your organisation.
lede: AI workforce reskilling strategy helps senior HR and workforce-planning leaders assess task changes and plan role transitions. The course covers role-impact assessment, transferable-skills mapping, pathway design, internal talent-marketplace planning, and measures for tracking reskilling outcomes and investment. It also introduces workforce analytics and automated skills inference, with attention to data quality, bias, privacy, and responsible use.
audienceIntro: This AI reskilling strategy course is designed for senior HR and organisational development professionals responsible for connecting AI-related workforce change with skills, talent pathways, and measurable learning investment.
outcomes: AI Role Redesign and Task Analysis
modules: AI Workforce Change and Role Impact
prerequisites: Recommended: experience in a senior HR, learning and development, workforce planning, talent management, or organisational development role. Familiarity with organisational job profiles and learning programmes will help you apply the exercises. Coding is not required; AI analytics and automated skills inference are introduced at operational-awareness level, not as technical implementation.
